OUTPUT.description: Folder of gate.json and record.json when --out and --record are not given.

OSF_NOW.description: The current time, like 2026-01-01T05:00:00Z, for escalation and expiry. Default: the clock.

PORT.description: serve: the port the HTTP server listens on.

GATEKEEPER_OPA.description: The OPA 1.x program that evaluates the policy.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_URL.description: Base URL of the Slack Web API, ending in a slash.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_TOKEN.description: Slack bot token with chat:write and channels:history. Required for a slack: channel.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET.description: serve: the signing secret of the Slack app, which checks every request from Slack. Required for serve.

GATEKEEPER_SLACK_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the channel port's slack adapter. It gets GATEKEEPER_SLACK_URL, GATEKEEPER_SLACK_TOKEN and GATEKEEPER_SLACK_SIGNING_SECRET as CHANNEL_API_URL, CHANNEL_TOKEN and CHANNEL_SIGNING_SECRET.

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_URL.description: The forge's URL as its forge adapter takes it in FORGE_URL: GitHub's API (default https://api.github.com for github.com), or the Forgejo's base URL (default the pull request's origin).

GATEKEEPER_FORGE_TOKEN.description: Token that may read the pull request, comment on it and set its commit status; the forge adapter gets it as FORGE_TOKEN. Never written to a file.

GATEKEEPER_GITHUB_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the forge port's github adapter, for a pull request on github.com.

GATEKEEPER_FORGEJO_ADAPTER.description: The command line of the forge port's forgejo adapter, for a pull request on any other forge.

GATEKEEPER_SIGNING_KEY.description: Ed25519 private key in PEM that signs each record. Without it the record is unsigned.

GATEKEEPER_NATS_URL.description: NATS server, like nats://localhost:4222, for the events gate.requested@v1 and gate.decided@v1. Unset: no events. serve keeps them in its outbox while NATS is unreachable.

GATEKEEPER_DATABASE_URL.description: serve: the PostgreSQL database, like postgres://gatekeeper@db/gatekeeper, for the gates and the outbox. Required for serve.

GATEKEEPER_API_TOKEN.description: serve: the token that callers of the API send as Authorization: Bearer <token>. Required for serve. Never written to a file.
